student_request: I need to take a leave of absence next quarter for personal reasons. My student ID is S002.

steps.content: I need to take a leave of absence next quarter for personal reasons. My student ID is S002.

content.rationale: Funded students must arrange a funding suspension before LOA can be approved.
conditions: Contact the graduate office to initiate funding suspension.
LOA will be approved once funding hold is confirmed.

steps.content:
The Leave of Absence (LOA) request for next quarter is **conditionally approved**. 

**Conditions:**
1. You must contact the Graduate Office to initiate a funding suspension process (as your funding category is RA).
2. LOA approval will be finalized once the funding hold is confirmed.

**Rationale:**  
Per university policy (POLICY-LOA-003), students with active funding must ensure their financial arrangements are suspended before an LOA can be granted. This applies to your situation as an RA. 

Please reach out to the Graduate Office within the next two weeks to proceed. If you need assistance with this, I’m here to help!
